Container.Name: Videola
Container.Overview:
A video editor that runs in the browser: import, cut, keyframe, grade, mix and export, with the project model and the command bus in a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly. This container serves the editor, an HTTP API and an MCP server for agents from one Node process.
Set a token. Every /api call needs it as an Authorization: Bearer header, and the server refuses to bind anything but loopback without one.
Projects and media live in the /data volume. That is the directory to include in a backup.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: video editor timeline cut export mp4 keyframes grading audio surround webassembly mcp

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the editor and the API answer on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Projects and imported media. The one path worth backing up.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Required. Every /api call carries it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and the server will not listen on a reachable address without one. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

Config.Name: Interface language
Config.Description: `en` or `de`. What the server writes into generated names and messages; the editor itself follows the browser.

Config.Name: Open projects at once
Config.Description: How many projects the server keeps open in memory. Each one holds its own core instance.
